name: moe-council-builder
displayName: MoE Council Builder — Standing Councils in the MoE-Gated Model
description: Build a new standing council in the MoE-gated deliberation model ('all hear, few speak'): expert-persona seats with three-level progressive disclosure (L0 roster always in context, L1 charters loaded only for gated-HOT seats, L2 references on demand), a Moderator that routes the 2-4 most relevant seats per agenda item, a ONE-batched-cheap-model-call warm sweep so every other seat still listens and can be promoted on a substantive cross-domain flag, and a human ratifier holding the final word. The skill carries the generic model spec, an 8-step build process with gates and anti-patterns, and copy-paste templates (roster, seat charter, session brief, warm sweep, Moderator SKILL.md, skill.json manifest). Invoke whenever a new council, advisory board or standing expert-persona panel is being created in any of the holding's organizations, or when someone asks how to run many personas at minimal token cost.
author: RiseGen AI

usage.aiAssistants: Invoke before creating any new council/standing persona panel; read SKILL.md, then follow references/build-process.md's 8 gated steps using references/templates.md, keeping the hard invariants (one deployable unit; L0/L1/L2 disclosure budgets 15/600/300/500; warm sweep = ONE batched cheapest-model call; every seat has a warm-sweep lens; a named human ratifier; the council governs its own composition). Validate with a measured pilot vs. an all-seats-hot baseline.
usage.engineers: The generic MoE-gated deliberation spec, the build process with gates and anti-patterns, and all package templates.
usage.founders: A repeatable way to stand up expert councils for any venture at near-flat token cost as rosters grow; every council ends in a human-ratified synthesis.
